_template_meta.name: booking-google-calendar
_template_meta.description: Inbound appointment booking with Google Calendar availability check + create. Hebrew-friendly. Replace the GCal tool_id placeholders with the IDs returned by your /tools POSTs.

metadata.purpose: Book a 30-min appointment in the company calendar

nodes.name: Greet and ask what's needed
nodes.instructions: Greet the caller warmly. Ask what kind of appointment they need and roughly when. ONE question at a time, no list.

transitions.label: Caller said what they need AND a time window
Caller said what they need but no time window
Caller wants to talk to a human, not book
Caller dialed by mistake or has the wrong company

nodes.name: Get a specific date and time
nodes.instructions: Get a SPECIFIC date and time (not a range). If the caller says 'sometime next week', narrow them down to a day. Capture the requested datetime into slot 'requested_start_iso' (ISO-8601 in caller's timezone). Confirm back what you heard before proceeding.

transitions.label: Caller gave a specific date and time, confirmed
Caller is still vague or needs help deciding

nodes.name: Offer 2-3 default slots
nodes.instructions: Offer 2-3 sensible default slots within business hours over the next 5 business days. Pick one with the caller.

transitions.label: Caller picked one of the suggested slots
None of the suggested slots work for the caller

nodes.name: Confirm before booking
nodes.instructions: Read back the date, time, and purpose. Ask the caller to confirm before we book it.

transitions.label: Caller wants to change the date or time

nodes.name: Confirm and offer next steps
nodes.instructions: Confirm the booking is done. Tell them they'll get a calendar invite by email. Ask if there's anything else.

transitions.label: Caller has nothing else, ready to hang up
Caller has another question or request

nodes.transfer_message: One moment, connecting you to our team.

nodes.name: Apologize for tool failure
nodes.instructions: The calendar action failed. Apologize briefly, take down the caller's preferred date/time, tell them someone will call back to confirm.

transitions.label: Caller gave their preferred time and is ok with callback

nodes.farewell: Thank you for calling. Someone will call you back to confirm your appointment shortly. Have a great day.
Thanks for calling, have a great day.

nodes.name: booking_summary
nodes.extraction_prompt: Extract the booking outcome from the transcript.

nodes.name: handoff_summary
nodes.extraction_prompt: Capture what the human team needs to call back about.
